newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Most offers flat in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Most offers flat in slow trade.

text.p: Soybean meal offers were mostly steady Tuesday in very quiet holiday-type trading, brokers said.

"It may be real slow through the first week in January," said one Indiana-based dealer. "Most people (end-users) have their needs bought for the holiday, so I don't expect to see a whole lot of activity."
CBOT futures were boosted by talk that China was seeking 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal for March delivery, but sources with ties to the export market were unable to confirm the business.
"I hope it is true because we (the U.S.) are certainly going to need the business in January," one broker said.

Some dealers were expecting a jump in business after the CBOT December contract expires at 1201 CST Thursday. December is trading at a large premium to January, and many dealers are uncertain about the direction the spread will take after expiration.
